exercises.q: The landscapes of Provence are very picturesque.
exercises.why: **живописны** — живопи́сный: picturesque, scenic; vivid. Wiktionary: жи́вопись + -ный.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.q: The villages in the Alps are very picturesque.
exercises.why: **живописны** — живопи́сный: picturesque, scenic; vivid. Wiktionary: жи́вопись + -ный.

exercises.q: How do you like living here?
exercises.why: **живётся** — жи́ться (imperfective): (impersonal) (for life) to be like, (for life) to go (used to describe conditions of life or existence). Wiktionary: жить + -ся.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: vital (relating to or characteristic of life), life
vivacity, liveliness, animation, vividness, alacrity, sprightliness
(transitive, intransitive) to live, to reside, to dwell
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: жи́зненный — vital (relating to or characteristic of life), life; жилец — lodger, tenant, roomer; inmate; жи́вость — vivacity, liveliness, animation, vividness, alacrity, sprightliness; прожива́ть — (transitive, intransitive) to live, to reside, to dwell.
